review.read_scope: operator_examples, equal/check/stride helpers; read-only formula/unit/threshold review
review.result: No formula revision requested. Suggested section names were corrected.
review.independence_limit: Reviewer authored the operator prose but not this arithmetic script; this is not independent review of their original prose.
review.concurrent_label_changes: During the read-only review, only section labels and additional_sections annotation were corrected; formulas and fixtures were unchanged. The reviewer-reported SHA equals the final script SHA. The writer separately checked every final section label against its chapter.

limits: All timings, capacities and workloads are synthetic declared inputs, not measurements.
Chapter hashes bind the accompanying text; fixtures are explicit and are not automatically extracted from prose.
A later chapter edit needs semantic review and, where its example changed, a fixture update.
These calculations do not establish backend legality, concurrency correctness, model quality, engine completion, knowledge usefulness or scientific novelty.
